items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no new discretionary spend, monetization expansion, budget commitment, forecast, requeue, or production work. AI spend was $963.569 across 5,390 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. Contribution margin, ROI, cost-to-learn, causal lift, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: period-aligned infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment costs, incremental outcomes, and approved financial limits are absent. Minimum measurement is an existing-work-only, period-aligned cost ledger matched to site/content-attributed commission, experiment-level cost and incremental outcomes, and owner-approved monthly limits. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, and failure repair-or-close review only; do not treat clicks, ordered items, sessions, impressions, technical scores, or conversion counts as financial return. Keep the private launch gate unchanged and external permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Maintain containment-only execution and authorize no new discretionary spend, monetization expansion, budget commitment, forecast, requeue, or production work. Revenue and cost evidence do not support ROI, margin, cost-to-learn, causal-lift, or budget claims. Continue existing measurement and attribution reconciliation using available source-dated data only; preserve aggregate revenue as unattributed.
